Name: Round Chickens Mod
Author: SpaghettiLord1010
Description:
This mod replaces the normal sprites for all of the chickens and transforms them into [b]adorable little balls which roll around[/b].

Hope you like it!.

Downloads.Description: This are the files, you just Need to copy the folder "RoundChickensMod" into the Mods Folder of StardewValley.

Manifest.Name: Round Chickens Mod
Manifest.Description: This mod replaces the sprites of all the chickens with cute rolling chickens.
